comparison.objective: Rotate an open shell 90 degrees around a separately held shaft in midair; candidate finishes inserts installed in a fixed representative shell base.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual free-space relative-pose control of two lifted bodies versus holding a mandrel coaxially in recessed inserts while the other arm hammers, then recovering fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Measured 90-degree shell-to-shaft orientation with both bodies clear of the table versus four contact-driven fractures, retained coils, contained tangs, no damage, and stable release.
comparison.reason: The shared shell context and bimanual coordination are generic; relative clocking in free space does not test impact fracture, insert retention, or fragment recovery.
